summary: Pull requests opened by schickling-assistant run hosted CI for checks no signature covers, instead of failing them with 'sign it with scripts/st-test --all --push origin'

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: CI only. .st/evidence-signed-only.json no longer lists schickling-assistant; myobie stays listed. A check covered by valid signed evidence still skips for every opener. The list is read at the accepted base, so the change applies to pull requests whose base contains it.

manual.detail: Agents opening pull requests as schickling-assistant no longer open a second copy from another account to get CI.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. Adding the login back to the list restores the refusal.
